reuse.why: Adds the rule in the existing shared getMonthWideCategories selection used by setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the averages, and in the getBudgetData path that copyPreviousMonth already uses.

duplication.why: The tag test is one isFixedGroupNote predicate; only the notes LEFT JOIN is repeated in the two existing queries.

placement.why: The rule lives in budget/actions.ts next to the month-wide selection and the other exclusions.

scope.why: Only the selection queries, the predicate, the copy-previous-month check and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: One named predicate applied in both category-selection paths is easy to follow; the two paths (selection function vs copyPreviousMonth's own loop) remain separate as they were before.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions that use getMonthWideCategories get the rule through it; copyPreviousMonth, which already used getBudgetData, calls the same predicate.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated beyond the shared JOIN clause in the two existing queries.

one_place.where: isFixedGroupNote / FIXED_GROUP_TAG in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by getMonthWideCategories and copyPreviousMonth, the two category-selection paths of the month-wide actions.
